16d2:
Open the door to an exciting career in diverse settings! Concordia University of Edmonton’s 15-month Environmental Health (After Degree) allows students to enter careers in provincial and federal government, private industry, and as consultants.

Students will analyze case studies that focus on employer needs and the changing field. Upon completion of this program, students will be well-versed in topics related to the health of communities as a whole.

Environmental Health is the practice protecting public health by applying relevant provincial legislation and providing supports to mitigating the physical, chemical, and biological risks found in the natural and man-made environment.

Environmental Health professionals are focused on prevention, consultation, investigation, communicable disease control and health promotion activities aimed at ensuring safe and healthy:

  • Water supplies
  • Food establishments
  • Personal service facilities
  • Swimming pools and recreational water
  • Housing: rental swellings, long term care and childcare facilities.
7byn:
Cybersecurity is no longer just for coders and IT people. The world needs leaders who understand information security. Cybersecurity has become an essential component of all businesses and organizations, from SMOs to Global Enterprises and governments, with many roles being filled by non-technical employees.

With this emphasis in Cybersecurity, this Management degree will make learners a valuable addition to any organization. The demand for cybersecurity skills is growing at an exponential rate, and this degree will provide students with the knowledge and skills necessary for the leaders of today and tomorrow.

Students will explore seven domains of knowledge recommended by industry professionals and societies in cybersecurity:

  • Security Governance, Administration, and Operations Management
  • Identity and Access Management
  • Risk Identification, Monitoring, and Analysis
  • Contingency Planning (BIA, IR, DR, BC-BR)
  • Network and Communication Security
  • Systems and Application Security
  • Security Assessment and Testing

With knowledge and skills in these domains, graduates will position themselves to contribute more, and advance their career further in whichever industry they choose to work in.
vfn:
Students can tailor their 4-year Bachelor of Management degree to their interests, by selecting the emphases of their choice.

Initially, students will establish a solid foundation of technical competence and skills with courses such as accounting, finance, information technology, management ethics, and international business, all the while developing effective management skills.

As the only university in Alberta to offer Data Management, students will gain an understanding and working knowledge of large data sets, data analysis methods, and the ability to make business decisions based on data.

Acquiring, validating, processing, and understanding data is an important skill for any workplace. Governments analyze census data to inform their programming and policies; the business world uses data to gauge consumer interest and inform marketing strategies, and all industries gather and analyze data to improve their output and efficiencies.

With this emphasis, students can work in any career, from retail and public health to banking and transportation. The opportunities are endless!
i6p:
Financial analysts and planners are experts at making recommendations to individuals and organizations, and suggesting best practices for achieving their financial goals.

Taking this emphasis will give students the skills and expertise to explore all aspects of financial management and decision-making. Learn how to:

  • help clients identify their personal and financial goals
  • assist corporations as they make their financial decisions
  • discover strategies on how individual investors can select and manage their investment opportunities
  • managing personal, corporate, and public finance portfolios
  • handle mergers and acquisitions
  • Become the “best asset” in any organization when students pursue career options such as financial advisor, financial analyst, investment analyst, loan officer, and trader.
i6e:
The 3-year and 4-year biology programs at Concordia University of Edmonton are designed to give students a broad understanding of the foundational concepts in biology. Students will be exposed to extensive laboratory experience that supports and expands upon concepts discussed in lecture while allowing them to gain a variety of practical skills. The emphasis streams in the 4-year program (Cellular and Molecular Biology, and Integrative Biology) provide students with the opportunity to study a particular area of biology in depth within the context of a liberal arts education.

Graduates have acquired knowledge and skills such as thinking analytically, researching, and understand interactions between organisms at various levels. These skills will allow entry into laboratory or field jobs, or further study in areas such as Education and Public Health. As a graduate of the 4-year program, students will be prepared for entry to graduate or professional school, a career, and professional certification by, for example, the Alberta Society of Professional Biologists.

i7d:
The need for information systems and security professionals is growing along with increasing reliance of businesses and governments on the technology. The demand for information systems security and assurance professionals shows no end in sight. This program maintains a sharp focus on the needs of employers and changes in industry. The Assurance program focuses on the business aspect of IT and prospective candidates are expected to have a background in both technology and accounting/finance.

This program follows the Information Systems Audit and Control Association (ISACA) model curriculum and follow ISACA best practices and normally encourage students to pursue a COBIT 2019 Foundation certification during the program and some consider other COBIT 2019 certifications and other ISACA certifications.
i7e:
Concordia University of Edmonton is proud to bring students a unique, mature and much-needed Information Systems Security program.

The need for security professionals is growing along with increasing reliance of businesses and governments on IT. The employer demand for information systems security professionals shows no end in sight. The program maintains a sharp focus on the needs of employers and changes in industry.

The program allows students preparation time for writing the certification exam for Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP). Some students/graduates also choose to write the certification exam for Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) as well as Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA).
269k:
This Master’s program provides students with a well-balanced curriculum to explore, covering topics from the foundations of advanced IT through to emerging technologies including artificial intelligence and machine learning.

Students will learn to distinguish and deal with complex and unpredictable professional IT environments as they develop the necessary soft skills to communicate their ideas, issues and conclusions clearly and effectively to both specialist and non-specialist audiences.
